description:
FILED s473t2 (Opus triage of the 152 causeless blessed sweep rows), on main 0d783d24.
Source: perl-tests/pos.t 23-25, 59-60, 129-135.

ROWS BEHIND IT: perl-tests/pos.t 4 ("pos() set inside //g"), 12 ("pos *glob
works"), 26 ("no assertion failure when getting pos clobbers ref with undef")
= 3 rows.  NOT the same as #396 / #966 / #261, which own `pos` on an AGGREGATE
ELEMENT (pos.t 15/16/18/19/20/21, already attributed).

(a) pos inside the replacement of s///g (pos.t:24):
      $x = "test string?"; $x =~ s/\w/pos($x)/eg; print $x;
    perl: 0123 5678910?          PCL: " ?"  (the replacement is empty every time)
(b) pos on a glob (pos.t:59-60):
      eval 'pos *a = 1'; print eval 'pos *a';
    perl: 1                      PCL: undef
(c) a foreach alias to pos() as an lvalue (pos.t:129-135):
      for my $one (pos $x) { for my $two (pos $x) { $one = \1; $two = undef;
        print defined $one ? "$one" : 'undef' } }
    perl: undef                  PCL: SCALAR(0x1)
    -- the two aliases are not the same place, so clobbering through $two is not
    seen through $one.
subject: BUG (pos residue): `pos()` is not set during an `s///eg` replacement, `pos *glob` is undef, and a `foreach` alias to `pos $x` does not write through (perl-tests/pos.t 4/12/26)
